# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import json, urllib.request
TOK = open('/root/nocodb-token.txt').read().strip()
r = urllib.request.Request('http://localhost:8080/api/v2/tables/m58xsjo6at01ohl/records?limit=500&fields=Id,%D0%A3%D0%B3%D0%BE%D0%B4%D0%B0,%D0%9A%D0%BB%D1%96%D1%94%D0%BD%D1%82,%D0%A4%D0%B0%D0%B9%D0%BB%D0%B8', headers={'xc-token': TOK})
d = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(r))
for x in d['list']:
    f = x.get('Файли')
    if isinstance(f, str):
        try: f = json.loads(f)
        except Exception: f = []
    if not f: continue
    print('=== угода %s · %s · рядок Id=%s · файлів: %d ===' % (x.get('Угода'), x.get('Клієнт'), x.get('Id'), len(f)))
    for i, a in enumerate(f):
        print('  [%d] %s' % (i, str(a.get('title'))[:90]))
        p = str(a.get('path') or '')
        if '/20' in p:
            print('       завантажено (з шляху): %s' % p.split('/download/')[-1][:11] if 'download' in p else p[:40])
